placements.why: The content asserts a strategic thesis about intelligence ownership — that owned intelligence differs categorically from rented intelligence and that durable value resides in perspective, not substrate. No existing strata category holds strategic theses; this content calls for one.
placements.title: intelligence as a strategic asset, not a rented utility
placements.frame: What strategic claims does this content make about owning versus renting intelligence?

placements.title: owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
placements.frame: Where does the durable value of intelligence reside — in the substrate you could rent or the perspective you keep?
placements.why: src-2 draws the categorical distinction between owned and rented intelligence; src-3 locates the retained value in perspective against a commodified substrate. Together they perform one coherent thesis about where durable intelligence value resides — a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding.
